evidence_model.root_rule: Every evidence object has one root. Derived objects may enrich interpretation but cannot independently increase confidence.

dependency_examples.t_square_and_component_squares: same aspect-pattern dependency group for confidence counting
dependency_examples.chart_ruler_and_its_placement: chart ruler is status metadata; its placement is one placement root

evidence_model.composite_dependency_rule: If a composite relation/pattern and one or more of its constituent facts are all cited, they share one dependency bundle and contribute at most one support unit to the minimum-evidence count. The composite may increase relevance/ranking but not inflate independence.

tension_emission_rule.ban: Do not manufacture a contradiction just to make the reading sound nuanced.

algorithm: connect source house -> ruler destination house
detect cycles and collapse them into one reciprocal motif
house_ruler_synthesis.self_loop: Interpret as concentration of that house topic, not infinite reinforcement.
house_ruler_synthesis.cycle: Interpret reciprocal coupling once; no repeated score multiplication.
house_ruler_synthesis.same_ruler_multiple_houses: Shared ruler creates a linkage, but the planet does not gain extra weight merely because the zodiac gives it multiple domiciles.

aspect_synthesis.rule: First describe the relation between planetary functions. Then use each sign and house to show how/where the relation manifests. Do not infer aspect quality from sign archetype alone.

slow_planet_priority.personal_outer: potentially personal if orb/house/angle supports it

section_novelty.rule: If a later section repeats an earlier theme, it must add a domain-specific mechanism, trade-off, or application; otherwise merge or omit it.

career_language.allowed_output: môi trường làm việc, kiểu vai trò, dạng nhiệm vụ và điều kiện phát huy
career_language.ban: Do not state a single best career as destiny.

banned_writer_behavior: treat South Node as independent evidence
equate MC with House 10 in all house systems
force a tension without both poles
stop after one explanatory paragraph when evidence supports deeper synthesis
inflate word count by restating the same placement in different adjectives
explain methodology repeatedly inside user prose
end every paragraph with a coaching or integration sentence
use the same contrast template repeatedly
inflate depth by adding defensive caveats
pattern_rule: Aspect patterns are topological summaries of aspect edges. A T-square does not count as three new independent facts in addition to its opposition and squares.

required_moves_per_major_section: cơ chế từ nhiều yếu tố
yếu tố điều chỉnh hoặc đối trọng
liên hệ sang domain khác khi có căn cứ
hướng tích hợp hoặc câu hỏi tự quan sát
narrative_depth_contract.rule: Depth follows chart signal density. Natural prose takes priority over uniform section length.
